title: Fix Create Question dialog transparency and make question text optional

requirements.summary: Change the Create Question dialog background from dark/transparent overlay to a solid white background to improve text readability
acceptanceCriteria: Dialog background is solid white with no transparency
All text labels and input fields are clearly visible against the white background
Dialog maintains proper contrast ratios for accessibility

file_operations.description: Update the Dialog component styling to use a solid white background instead of the default dark/transparent overlay. Modify the DialogContent className to include 'bg-white' and remove any transparency-related classes. Ensure all text elements (labels, placeholders, help text) have sufficient contrast against the white background by using appropriate text color classes (e.g., 'text-gray-900', 'text-gray-700').

requirements.summary: Remove the asterisk (*) from the Question Text field label and make the field truly optional to support image-only questions
acceptanceCriteria: Question Text field label does not display an asterisk
Form validation allows submission with empty Question Text when Question Image is provided
Users can successfully create questions with only images and no text

file_operations.description: Remove the asterisk (*) from the 'Question Text' field label by updating the label text from 'Question Text *' to 'Question Text'. Update the form validation logic to make questionText optional when a question image is provided. Modify the validation schema or validation function to check: if questionText is empty, require that questionImage is not null; if both are empty, show an error indicating at least one is required. Update the onSave/handleSubmit handler to allow submission when questionText is empty but questionImage is present.

requirements.summary: Ensure all four option input fields are fully visible and properly spaced within the Create Question dialog layout
acceptanceCriteria: All four option input fields (Option A, B, C, D) are visible without scrolling
Option fields have adequate spacing between them
Dialog height accommodates all fields comfortably

file_operations.description: Adjust the dialog layout to ensure all four option input fields are visible without scrolling. Increase the DialogContent maxHeight or remove height constraints that may be causing truncation. Add consistent vertical spacing (e.g., 'space-y-3' or 'gap-3') between option input fields. Review the overall dialog structure and consider using 'max-h-[90vh]' with 'overflow-y-auto' on the scrollable content area (not the entire dialog) to ensure all fields fit within the viewport while maintaining accessibility on smaller screens.
